selected_script.angle: Clearing cluttered, sun-bleached spices from the kitchen window sill to restore natural light and block heat damage, mounting them on the refrigerator side wall
selected_script.hook: Stop crowding your kitchen window sill with spice jars that block the light and spoil in the sun.

timeline.scene: Close-up of a hand trying to open a kitchen window, accidentally knocking over spice jars cluttered on the narrow window sill, capturing the mess and frustration.
The hand directly places a matte black metal magnetic spice rack onto the side of a white refrigerator. The rack holds spice jars neatly.
Close-up of the matte black rack attached to the fridge, showing it securely holding spice jars with a detachable metal hook hanging from the bottom edge holding an oven mitt.
Show a second matte black magnetic metal rack mounted lower on the refrigerator side wall, holding two olive oil bottles securely without slipping.
A wide shot showing two matte black magnetic racks neatly organized on the refrigerator side, while the adjacent kitchen window sill is now completely empty, clean, and bright.
Display a light CTA text overlay reading 'Make your space cleaner and cozier.'
